coordinates.forward_of_room: -Z points from the gallery towards the judge
coordinates.character_facing: +Z at yaw 0 (towards the gallery); yaw_rad rotates about +Y
coordinates.note: Positions are already converted from Blender (x, y, z) to three.js (x, z, -y).

threejs_notes.bone_names: GLTFLoader sanitises 'mixamorig:Hips' to 'mixamorigHips' (same as Mixamo FBX in three.js).
threejs_notes.face_layer: Clips with layer=='face' only animate morph weights; play them on a second AnimationAction alongside a body clip.
threejs_notes.in_place: Walk/turn clips are in place. Move the root yourself (Walk speed_mps in clip meta).
threejs_notes.lods: LOD1/LOD2 GLBs contain no clips; play LOD0 clips on them via AnimationMixer (same bone names).

recommended_lighting.fill_points: use lights_reference sconces (warm #ffd19a) at 2-4 cd; ceiling panels as RectAreaLights
recommended_lighting.tone_mapping: ACESFilmic or AgX, exposure 1.0, sRGB output
